---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with setup, a tool, or a profile edit
---

## What happened?

Describe what you expected and what happened instead.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the MCP tool and sanitized arguments if known. Use a disposable profile for write-related reproductions.

## Environment

- STREONOR MCP version or commit
- Device model and STREONOR app version
- Operating system and MCP client

Share only relevant, redacted error text. Keep tokens, personal profiles, and vulnerability details private. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/lde-medeiros/streonor-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for security reporting.
